mapper.select: select bm_weigh_execute_weigh_record.id, bm_weigh_execute_weigh_record.storage_material_id, bm_weigh_execute_weigh_record.storage_material_no, bm_material.name as material_name, bm_material.merge_code as material_merge_code, bm_material_category.category_type, bm_weigh_execute_weigh_record.storage_material_batch_no, bm_weigh_execute_weigh_record.tare_weight, bm_weigh_execute_weigh_record.gross_weight, bm_weigh_execute_weigh_record.net_weight, bm_weigh_execute_weigh_record.unit_id, bm_product_plan.product_name, bm_product_plan.product_merge_code, bm_product_plan.batch_no, bm_product_plan.process_name, bm_weigh_execute_weigh_record.weigher_id, bm_weigh_execute_weigh_record.re_checker_id, bm_weigh_execute_weigh_record.weigh_time, bm_weigh_execute_weigh_record.container_name, bm_weigh_execute_weigh_record.material_position_name, bm_weigh_execute_weigh_record.weigh_type, bm_weigh_execute_weigh_record.sign_status from bm_weigh_execute_weigh_record left join bm_weigh_task on bm_weigh_task.id = bm_weigh_execute_weigh_record.task_id and bm_weigh_task.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_material on bm_material.id = bm_weigh_task.material_id and bm_material.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_product_plan on bm_product_plan.id = bm_weigh_execute_weigh_record.product_plan_id and bm_product_plan.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_material_category on bm_material_category.id = bm_material.material_category_id and bm_material_category.is_deleted = 0 where bm_weigh_execute_weigh_record.is_deleted = 0 and bm_weigh_execute_weigh_record.task_id = #{taskId} order by weigh_time desc
